svg.title: 2023–2026 · hands-on, edge devices, agents: the five tracks for these years, key events labelled, every dot with its date on hover; the tracks light up one at a time

circle.title: 2023 · AI assistants in browsers, IDEs, SaaS — Copilots everywhere.

g.text: AI assistants in browsers, IDEs, SaaS

circle.title: 2023 · LSA protection default (enterprise) — New enterprise-joined installs, 22H2 and later.
2023 · Volt Typhoon advisory — CISA AA23-144A, 24 May 2023: living off the land as the whole campaign.
2023 · Extortion without encryption — Cl0p and MOVEit, May–June 2023.
2023 · State prepositioning — Volt Typhoon: not paid at all.
2023 · Cl0p MOVEit — Exploitation from about 27 May 2023.
2023 · Identity threat detection and response — The sensor moves to the identity provider.
2023 · Scattered Spider: MGM, Caesars — September 2023; help-desk calls and MFA resets.
2023 · Help-desk SE against casinos — Payout justifies live social engineering.
2023 · ECH in Chrome and Firefox — September–October 2023; Cloudflare default for free zones.
2023 · Passkeys in Windows 11 — September 2023.
2023 · Citrix Bleed — CVE-2023-4966, October 2023.

2023 · Collaboration tools as the new mail — Storm-0324 phishes through Teams with SharePoint-hosted files (Microsoft, 12 September 2023); Black Basta's fake help-desk Teams calls from May 2024; Discord's content network hosted payloads until it moved to expiring links, November 2023.

2024 · Edge devices: Citrix Bleed, Ivanti, Fortinet — Citrix Bleed October 2023, Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days January 2024, Fortinet SSL-VPN February 2024: appliances that run no EDR become the main entry point.

g.text: Edge devices: Citrix Bleed, Ivanti, Fortinet

circle.title: 2024 · CISA LOTL guidance; baselining — 7 February 2024.
2024 · Fortinet SSL-VPN — CVE-2024-21762, February 2024.
2024 · Session tokens as the product — A token opens the SaaS tenant where the data lives.
2024 · XZ Utils backdoor — Found 29 March 2024: a maintainer identity built over two years to plant a backdoor in a Linux compression library on the path to SSH.
2024 · ClickFix — The user pastes the command; first observed March 2024.
2024 · Snowflake customer breaches — May–June 2024: infostealer credentials with no MFA opened about 165 customer tenants; data stolen and extorted without touching a host.

2024 · CrowdStrike outage; EDR out of the kernel — 19 July 2024: a faulty sensor update crashed about 8.5 million Windows hosts. Microsoft's Windows Resiliency Initiative (November 2024) moves endpoint security out of kernel mode.

g.text: CrowdStrike outage; EDR out of the kernel

circle.title: 2024 · LLM triage in the SOC — Reasoning applied on the defensive side.

2024 · Salt Typhoon (telecoms) — Disclosed September–November 2024: a state actor inside carrier networks, reaching call records and data held for court-ordered law-enforcement requests; in through edge equipment.
2024 · Agent protocols (MCP) — Tool-using agents become products.
2025 · Bybit heist (North Korea) — 21 February 2025: about $1.5 billion in cryptocurrency, the largest theft on record; FBI attribution on 26 February.

2025 · Firmware botnets in consumer devices — BADBOX (identified 2023) and BADBOX 2.0 (FBI warning, 5 June 2025): Android TV boxes and other devices backdoored before purchase. XCPE, disclosed 2 November 2026: the backdoor in the manufacturer's own firmware on more than 1.3 million set-top boxes.
2025 · Project Ire — Microsoft, 5 August 2025: agentic malware analysis.
2025 · ForcedLeak (hijacked agent) — Noma Security, 25 September 2025.
2025 · Windows 10 end of support — 14 October 2025.

2025 · AI-orchestrated espionage campaign reported — Anthropic, 13 November 2025: a state-linked operator had an agent run most of an intrusion campaign; agent-assisted extortion had been reported in August 2025.
2025 · Guardrails, agent observability — The sensor moves into the agent harness.
2026 · ECH standardized (RFC 9849) — March 2026; server-side adoption still narrow.

2026 · ATT&CK adds Defense Impairment — ATT&CK v19, 28 April 2026: Defense Evasion split into Stealth and Defense Impairment. v20, 13 October 2026, adds Impair Autonomous Defenses, including prompt injection against LLM-assisted analysis (slide 16).
2026 · Autonomous agent intrusion — Hugging Face technical timeline of the July 2026 incident.

2026 · File-based implants persist: NIK C2, VOLTA — Talos, October 2026: NIK C2, a Go remote-access tool with an OpenAI client; VOLTA, a built-to-order infostealer that sends the stolen bundle to an LLM to rank the victim's assets. Still PE files for sale.

2026 · Bandwidth as the product again — XCPE, disclosed 2 November 2026: a device manufacturer sells access to more than 1.3 million set-top boxes to affiliates for residential proxies and ad fraud. The botnet-for-hire model of 2005, on devices no one patches.

2026 · Browser-resident C2 (Falcon/XG) — Unit 42, 11 November 2026: the implant is JavaScript in a browser tab or a sideloaded extension, no host file; a tab injection is scoped to one site, an extension hijacks the whole browser. The same actor drops a native Rust implant (Antino) via a fake Adobe Flash update.
